rows.headline: Can NRIs use the basic tax exemption limit to reduce their tax liability?
rows.hook: Tax rules differ for non-resident Indians
rows.summary: Non-Resident Indians often wonder whether they can claim the basic tax exemption limit to lower their tax liability in India. The eligibility depends on their residential status for the specific financial year under the Income Tax Act. NRIs are taxed only on their India-sourced income, unlike residents who are taxed on global income. Understanding these provisions helps retail investors correctly file taxes and claim applicable deductions on domestic investments.

rows.hook: Safety of 10 million Indians in Gulf

rows.hook: Private investment lag threatens long-term growth
rows.summary: Deloitte forecasts India's GDP growth to reach 7.1–7.3% in FY27, driven by sustained household consumption and public infrastructure spending. Sustained economic expansion depends on a recovery in private investment to complement government-led growth. This outlook provides a benchmark for long-term macroeconomic expectations in the Indian market.
rows.why_it_matters: Private investment recovery is crucial for sustained corporate earnings growth.

rows.headline: US Fed Chair Kevin Warsh says AI will transform monetary policy and the global economy
rows.hook: AI will fundamentally transform global central banking
rows.summary: US Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh stated during the IMF Annual Meetings in Bangkok that artificial intelligence will fundamentally reshape how central banks conduct monetary policy. Warsh noted that AI investment initially boosts economic demand and may add to inflationary pressures before delivering a positive supply shock through productivity gains. He added that advanced AI tools could help central banks interpret economic indicators and make better policy decisions, though the transition may cause uncertainty for jobs and markets. Indian retail investors should monitor these global monetary shifts as Fed policy decisions directly influence foreign institutional capital flows into Indian markets.
rows.why_it_matters: Fed policy shifts driven by AI will influence global capital flows to India.
